theater: 卡烏迪內山口與利里斯河谷

battle.name: 第二次薩莫奈戰爭
battle.theater: 卡烏迪內山口與利里斯河谷
battle.brief: 公元前327至304年，羅馬在安科納使者被殺後一次徵召四個戰團，自利里斯河谷深入薩莫奈丘陵，打到卡普阿城下，並在卡烏迪內山口設伏重創薩莫奈聯軍主力，迫其議和。卡面亞述長矛是前九世紀兩河流域的短柄長刃鐵矛，本役並無實物，只作對照：薩莫奈人用投槍、寬身短劍與亞麻胸甲，羅馬戰團用大盾與重標槍。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏈。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 第二次薩莫奈戰爭的交戰方，一方是羅馬共和國，另一方是薩莫奈聯盟。羅馬方面由兩位執政官分任統帥，宣戰與開拔須經公民大會決定，兵員來自羅馬城邦的徵召，並由拉丁同盟提供援軍；羅馬在戰役中依靠逐年的戰團編制、輔助軍與附庸盟邦的輕裝步兵打仗，軍械與攻城器械集中在羅馬的軍械庫製造。聯軍方面是一個沒有常備軍的部族聯盟，各城邦與各部族按盟約提供民兵，由聯盟議會決定作戰計畫，軍隊沒有統一編制，靠首領的個人信譽臨時聚合。聯盟的核心是阿普亞與博阿努姆兩座城，議會多在安科納召開，議會內部長期分裂成兩種主張：阿普亞的寡頭派主張與羅馬共存、避免正面衝突；薩拉斯特與基爾拉等山區城鎮的主張則是全面抗戰。公元前327年開戰時站在薩莫奈一邊的還有塔倫圖姆與坎帕尼亞諸城，前者以同盟條約與羅馬對抗，後者一度在卡普阿倒戈。拉丁同盟的態度是整場戰爭的關鍵變數：公元前325年拉丁諸城因不滿被排除在戰利品分配之外而醞釀兵變，羅馬用撤軍與重新訂約把他們拉回自己這一邊。埃特魯里亞人與翁布里亞人直到後期才加入聯軍。還要注意薩莫奈聯盟內部的裂痕：公元前327年羅軍進入山區時，希爾皮尼部族因為自己的首領不肯交出人質而倒向羅馬，羅馬人利用這道裂口攻下希爾皮尼人的城塞。整場戰爭沒有迦太基的介入；羅馬在南方的主要敵人當時仍在西西里，忙於第一次布匿戰爭，這讓羅馬得以把注意力全部放在義大利中部。
countriesEn: The opposing sides of the Second Samnite War were the Roman Republic on one hand and the Samnite League on the other. On the Roman side two consuls held command in turn, and both the declaration of war and the departure of the army required a vote of the comitia; the men came from the levy of the Roman citizen body, with reinforcements supplied by the Latin League. Rome fought the campaign on the strength of its annual legion establishment, its auxiliaries and the light infantry of its dependent communities, while its weapons and siege engines were turned out in the Roman fabrica. The other side was a tribal confederation with no standing army: each city and each people contributed militia by the terms of the alliance, the league council decided the plan of operations, and the troops had no uniform organisation, being gathered temporarily on the personal authority of their leaders. The core of the league was the two cities of Capua and Bovianum, and the council met usually at Ancona. Inside it two positions had long divided the league: the oligarchs of Capua argued for coexistence with Rome and for avoiding a direct clash, while the hill towns such as Sarastis and Ceraunia insisted on a war of decision. At the opening of the war in 327 BC, Tarentum stood with the Samnites under a treaty of alliance, as did the Campanian cities, one of which, Capua, revolted for a time. The attitude of the Latin League was the decisive variable in the whole war. In 325 BC the Latin cities grew restive at being left out of the distribution of the spoils and began to talk of revolt; Rome brought them back to its own side by withdrawing the legions and renewing the treaty. The Etruscans and Umbrians only joined the coalition in the later stages. One must also note the cracks inside the Samnite confederation: when the Roman army entered the hills in 327 BC, the Hirpini went over to Rome because their own chiefs refused to hand over hostages, and the Romans used that fissure to take the Hirpinian strongholds. Carthage was not involved in this war at all; Rome's main enemy in the south was still in Sicily, occupied with the First Punic War, and that left Rome free to concentrate entirely on central Italy.
people: 留下姓名的將領分屬兩邊。羅馬方面最關鍵的是蓋烏斯·佩特羅尼烏斯·圖拉米尼亞努斯，他於公元前327年當選第一任平民執政官，同時推行法律，規定兩位執政官中必須有一位出自平民，戰爭正好在他任內開打；同年的執政官還有盧基烏斯·帕皮里烏斯·庫爾索爾。帕皮里烏斯在這場戰爭中擔任六次執政官中的數次，是羅馬在山區戰役中最重要的指揮者：公元前320年他在卡烏迪內山口設伏全殲薩莫奈軍，公元前313年再度擊敗薩莫奈聯軍並為此舉行凱旋式，據李維記載，公民大會破例准許他在凱旋遊行中頭戴桂冠，因為他打的是本國邊境內的敵人而非外族。最後幾年對抗聯軍的是昆圖斯·法比烏斯·馬克西穆斯·魯利亞努斯，他以長期在山區指揮的經驗著稱。羅馬使者團的遭遇是導火線：李維在第八卷記下四名被殺害的使者，後世最常被點名的是昆圖斯·法比烏斯·維布拉努斯。薩莫奈方面留下名字的人很少，安科納議會上的首領們多數只有身分沒有姓名，可考的是一位名叫蓋米努斯的薩莫奈人，他在公元前326年的夜間戰中被羅馬人俘獲，這件事直接引發了後續的慘烈收場。史料方面，這場戰爭的主要記載是李維《羅馬史》第八、九卷；波利比奧斯在《歷史》第六卷留下最詳細的一段薩莫奈軍裝與營地描述，是後人研究薩莫奈人裝備的主要依據。
peopleEn: The commanders whose names survive fall on both sides. On the Roman side the most important was Gaius Petronius Turaminianus, elected the first plebeian consul in 327 BC; he carried the law that one of the two consuls must be a plebeian, and the war began in his year. His colleague was Lucius Papirius Cursor. Papirius held several of his six consulships in this war and was Rome's most important commander in the hill country: in 320 BC he annihilated the Samnite army in a forced march at the Caudine Forks, and in 313 BC he defeated the Samnite coalition again and was granted a triumph for it, Livy recording that the comitia made an exception and allowed him to wear a laurel wreath on his head during the procession, because he had conquered an enemy inside the Roman frontier rather than a foreign people. The last years against the coalition belong to Quintus Fabius Maximus Rullianus, remembered for long experience of command in the mountains. The fate of the Roman envoys is the spark of the whole business: Livy records four envoys murdered in the eighth book, the one most often named being Quintus Fabius Vibulanus. On the Samnite side very few names survive; the chiefs at the Ancona assembly are mostly identities without names. One Samnite whose name is known is Geminus, taken prisoner by the Romans in a night action in 326 BC, an event that directly produced the savage aftermath. As for the sources, the principal account of this war is Livy's eighth and ninth books of Ab Urbe Condata, while Polybius in the sixth book of his Histories preserves the most detailed description of Samnite arms and camp that survives, and is the main basis for every reconstruction of Samnite equipment.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛是前九世紀亞述帝國的近戰兵器：短柄、葉形長刃，鐵鏨套在柄端，柄上纏著皮帶以便握持與投擲，亞述人把它與弓、斧、矛一同配給步兵，靠密集方陣向前推壓。它並不是本役的實物。薩莫奈人的裝備有波利比奧斯的描述為據：小圓盾、寬身而微彎的雙刃短劍（希臘人稱之為薩莫奈劍）、用於投擲的細桿投槍，以及用亞麻繃製、層層編織的胸甲，這套輕裝但防禦極佳的組合讓薩莫奈步兵在近身格鬥中極為難纏；頭盔多為皮製或不戴，盾牌以木框蒙皮製成，弓與投石索則由山區部族使用。羅馬步兵的裝備是另一套：大型橢圓盾、銅製長桿加鐵矛頭的重標槍（可回收再用）、短劍、鎖子甲、青銅盔與釘底皮靴，重標槍配大盾，使羅馬戰團能在遠處以密集的槍幕壓制對手而少受還擊；羅馬另設軍械庫集中生產標槍與劍頭。攻城方面，羅馬在卡普阿與盧凱里亞修築圍城工事，用投射攻城武器與火攻對付城頭，薩莫奈人則以城上射擊與襲擾糧道回應；兩軍都有騎兵，薩莫奈騎兵在利里斯河谷的奇襲中切斷過羅馬的後隊與輸送隊。運輸依賴牛車與山道，羅馬在亞平寧山下的補給線長度是這場戰爭真正的瓶頸。卡面長矛在本役的意義只有對照：它標示出長矛這種兵器在地中海世界的古老源頭，而薩莫奈人與羅馬人手中真正在用的，都已經是窄刃、可投擲的短矛。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is a close-combat arm of the ninth-century Assyrian Empire: a short shaft carrying a long leaf-shaped blade, an iron socket fitted over the shaft end, and thong bindings on the grip for holding and throwing. The Assyrians issued it to the infantry alongside the bow, the axe and the spear, and pushed with it in dense formations. It is not a physical object from this campaign. The Samnite equipment is known from Polybius: a small round shield, a broad, slightly curved double-edged short sword that the Greeks called the Samnite sword, a light javelin thrown as a missile, and a cuirass of layered woven linen. That light but well protected combination made Samnite infantry extremely hard to handle in close fighting; the helmet was usually of leather or not worn at all, and the shield was a wooden frame covered with hide, while the bow and the sling belonged to the hill tribes. The Roman infantry carried a different set: the large oval scutum, the heavy pilum with a copper shaft and an iron head, which could be recovered and thrown again, a short sword, mail armour, a bronze helmet and boots with nailed soles. Shield and heavy javelin together let a Roman legion crush the enemy under a curtain of missiles at a distance and take comparatively few casualties. Rome also ran fabricae for the concentrated production of javelins and sword blades. On the siege side, the Romans built works around Capua and Luceria and used artillery and fire against the walls, while the Samnites answered with shooting from the ramparts and raids on the supply lines. Both armies had cavalry; Samnite horse in the Liris valley cut Roman columns and baggage trains off from the rear. Movement depended on ox carts and mountain roads, and the length of the Roman supply line under the Apennines was the real bottleneck of the war. The card's spear matters here only as a comparison: it marks the ancient Near Eastern ancestry of the spear as a weapon, while the spear actually in the hands of the Samnites and the Romans had already become a narrow-bladed, throwable short spear.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術主軸是隘口爭奪、攻城與聯盟拆解。開戰程序本身就是羅馬的制度展示：使者被殺之後，公民大會投票宣戰，四個戰團同時徵召，兩位執政官分兵多路作戰，兵團沿利里斯河谷、卡普阿與亞平寧東麓的幾條路同時推進，逼得薩莫奈人無法集中全軍應戰。當羅馬主力前推時，薩莫奈的戰法是不與主力正面對撞，改以騎兵襲擊羅軍側翼與糧道、在隘口與山口設阻、並拉攏坎帕尼亞與拉丁同盟的城市製造多點騷擾。公元前326年，聯軍夜襲羅馬在利里斯河谷的營地得手，羅馬反應極快：帕皮里烏斯·庫爾索爾率一柱部隊連夜行軍，攻破薩莫奈人的營壘，殘存守軍與被俘者慘遭屠殺，兩敗俱傷，羅馬人自己也付出慘重代價。卡普阿的攻防是另一個樣板：薩莫奈人策動坎帕尼亞諸城倒戈，一度奪下卡普阿，羅馬人則用佯退與夜襲的配合把城收回，顯示攻城技術與情報的重要性。公元前320年決定戰局的卡烏迪內山口一役，羅馬人選擇地形而不是硬攻：帕皮里烏斯把薩莫奈聯軍引入一條兩側峭壁夾峙、只有一端可通的死路，羅馬步兵佔據高地，以標槍與投石覆蓋谷底，再全軍下擊，摧毀營地並造成大量被俘。羅馬接著圍攻北方要衝盧凱里亞，奪城後把它設為據點，長期威脅東南方向。最後是外交手段：羅馬以錢財誘使埃特魯里亞人與翁布里亞人退出戰局，聯盟一旦失去這些盟友，薩莫奈人便無力再單獨對抗，這一著與任何一場會戰同等重要。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of this war was the fight for defiles, siege operations and the breaking up of the coalition. The opening procedure was itself a display of Roman institutions: after the envoys were killed, the comitia voted the war, four legions were levied at once, and the two consuls split their forces on several lines, marching along the Liris valley, from Capua and along the eastern foot of the Apennines, so that the Samnites could never bring their whole army to bear. When the Roman main body pressed forward, the Samnite answer was to avoid a set-piece engagement, to strike the Roman flanks and the supply lines with horse, to block the passes and mountain mouths, and to win over the Campanian and Latin cities so that trouble would break out in many places at once. In 326 BC the coalition attacked the Roman camp in the Liris valley by night and carried the day; the Roman reaction was quick. Lucius Papirius Cursor marched with a column by night, broke into the Samnite camp, and the survivors and the prisoners were cut down, leaving both sides badly mauled and the Romans themselves with a heavy price to pay. The operations around Capua form a second model: the Samnites stirred the Campanian cities into revolt and for a time took Capua, and the Romans recovered the city by combining a feigned withdrawal with a night attack, which shows the weight of siegecraft and intelligence. The battle that decided the campaign was fought at the Caudine Forks in 320 BC, and there the Romans chose the ground instead of forcing the issue: Papirius drew the Samnite coalition into a dead end between sheer cliffs with only one way out, the Roman infantry took the heights and covered the floor of the valley with javelins and stones, and then the whole army came down, destroying the camp and taking a great number of prisoners. Rome next besieged Luceria, the key point of the north, took it and made it a permanent base threatening the south-east. Last came the diplomatic stroke: Rome paid the Etruscans and Umbrians to leave the war, and once the allies had gone the Samnites could no longer stand alone. That measure was worth as much as any battle.
data: 可核的數字有限，逐一列出。年份：通行分期把第二次薩莫奈戰爭放在公元前328至304年，卡面採用的公元前327年起點對應李維記載中羅馬宣戰與開拔的那一年，羅馬人自己把它算到第九年。月份：卡面所標的月份是依開春出師推出的通行推定，李維只寫季節不寫月份。徵召：公元前327年羅馬一次徵召四個戰團，這在共和國早期是前所未有的一次大徵兵；以當時每個戰團約四千人上下推算，一次出動的兵力約一萬六千人，但這是編制推算而非本役實數，實際出征與損失在文獻中沒有留下。薩莫奈方面的兵力同樣無從核實，波利比奧斯只說薩莫奈人在義大利各部族中武裝最盛。城邑：卡普阿被奪又失而復得，盧凱里亞被羅馬攻下並設為據點，希爾皮尼人的城塞亦落入羅馬之手。距離：羅馬至卡普阿約一百六十公里，卡普阿至薩莫奈山區的核心地帶約五十至七十公里，卡烏迪內山口在卡普阿東北方約三十公里；這些距離說明羅馬的戰爭縱深遠遠超過前一次薩莫奈戰爭。時間：從公元前327年開戰到公元前304年議和，前後約二十三年，期間跨越近十次執政官任期。損失：確切的傷亡數字沒有保存下來，任何具體總數都不可信；可以確定的只有兩點，一是羅馬在此戰中第一次把公民徵召推到四個戰團的規模，二是薩莫奈聯盟在卡烏迪內山口一役損失了它最有戰鬥力的成建制部隊。物資：攻城所需的重投石、攻城塔與柴料，靠牛車自羅馬或坎帕尼亞的產地運上；標槍的矛桿由銅材供應，矛頭與劍由軍械庫製造；糧食為小麥與豆類，酒裝在陶甕裡由牛車運。
dataEn: Checkable numbers are few and are best given one by one. Dates: the usual division places the Second Samnite War between 328 and 304 BC, and the 327 BC start used on the card corresponds to the year in which Livy records the Roman declaration of war and the march out; the Romans themselves counted the war as reaching its ninth year. Month: the month on the card is a conventional reconstruction from the campaigning season, since Livy gives the season and no month. Levy: in 327 BC Rome levied four legions at once, a mobilisation without precedent in the early republic; on the reckoning of about four thousand men to a legion at that time, a force of some sixteen thousand went out, but that is an establishment estimate and not a return for this campaign, since neither the numbers present nor the losses are recorded. The Samnite strength is equally unverifiable; Polybius says only that the Samnites were the best armed of the peoples of Italy. Towns: Capua was taken, lost and retaken; Luceria was captured by the Romans and turned into a base; the Hirpinian strongholds also fell. Distances: about a hundred and sixty kilometres from Rome to Capua, fifty to seventy kilometres from Capua to the heart of the Samnite hills, and about thirty kilometres from Capua to the Caudine Forks, which tells how much deeper into the country this war reached than the first Samnite war had. Time: from the declaration in 327 BC to the peace of 304 BC, some twenty-three years, spanning close on ten consulships. Losses: no exact figures survive, and any specific total is untrustworthy; two things can be asserted. Rome for the first time pushed a citizen levy to the scale of four legions, and the Samnite coalition lost the best of its formed troops in the single day at the Caudine Forks. Stores: the stone for the artillery, the siege towers and the firewood came up on ox carts from the depots at Rome or in Campania; javelin shafts were supplied in copper and heads and blades were turned out in the fabrica; food was wheat and beans, and wine travelled in earthenware jars on the carts.
cause: 打起來的遠因是義大利中部勢力版圖的重新分配。第一次薩莫奈戰爭之後，羅馬把手伸進坎帕尼亞，把卡普阿視為姊妹城，薩莫奈人要求羅馬退出，羅馬不肯；此後羅馬在亞平寧一帶修路移民，把殖民地一座接一座推向山區，薩莫奈聯盟腹背受敵。阿普亞的寡頭派與山區的主戰派在開戰前已經分裂：前者認為薩莫奈人無法單獨對抗羅馬，應各自守土、避免刺激；後者認為只有決戰才有生路，於是把聯盟拖入全面戰爭。導火線發生在公元前328年冬：羅馬派往安科納要求歸還被扣羅馬商人、並要求薩莫奈各城停止騷擾的使者，在聯盟議會上被扣押並殺害。羅馬的公民大會隨即宣布開戰，一次徵召四個戰團，這在共和國史上尚無先例。雙方的算盤也很清楚：羅馬要的是坎帕尼亞的港口、稅源與南部通道，免得薩莫奈聯盟卡在自己與拉丁同盟之間；薩莫奈人要的是保住山區各城的獨立，並且把戰火引到羅馬盟友身上，使羅馬無法專心一致。拉丁同盟的態度是關鍵，羅馬在公元前325年面對拉丁諸城不滿時，用撤回軍隊、重新訂立同盟與執政官曼利烏斯·托爾庫阿圖斯的演說穩住了局面；正因為拉丁人留在了羅馬這邊，薩莫奈聯盟從頭到尾缺少一支足以改變戰局的援軍。
causeEn: The remote cause of the fighting was a redrawing of the balance of power in central Italy. After the First Samnite War Rome had put its hand into Campania, treated Capua as a sister city, and refused the Samnite demand to withdraw; from then on Rome built roads and settled colonies through the Apennines, pushing colonies towards the hill country step by step, and the Samnite League was squeezed from behind and from the front. Before the war opened, the league was already split: the oligarchs of Capua believed the Samnites could not stand alone against Rome and should each hold their own ground rather than give provocation, while the war party in the hills held that only a decision of battle could save them, and dragged the whole league into a general war. The spark came in the winter of 328 BC. Rome sent envoys to Ancona to demand the return of Roman merchants who had been seized and to require the Samnite cities to stop their raids; the envoys were detained and killed in the league council. The Roman comitia then declared war and levied four legions, a measure without precedent in republican history. The arithmetic on both sides was plain. Rome wanted the harbours, the taxes and the southern roads of Campania, and did not want the Samnite League lodged between itself and the Latin League. The Samnites wanted the independence of their hill cities preserved and the war carried onto the territory of Rome's allies, so that Rome could not act with one mind. The attitude of the Latin League was the hinge: when the Latin cities showed resentment in 325 BC, Rome steadied them by pulling the legions back, renewing the alliance and letting the consul Manlius Torquatus speak to them. Because the Latins stayed on Rome's side, the Samnite League was never able to muster a force that could turn the war.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是羅馬在義大利中部與南部確立了壓倒性的優勢，坎帕尼亞的港口、稅源與道路從此在羅馬手裡，阿普亞與各山區城邦則退守自保。但它並沒有把薩莫奈人清剿乾淨，這一點同樣重要：薩莫奈聯盟的領土、各城的政治結構與獨立的軍事傳統大致保留，債務與戰俘也沒有被清算，於是公元前298年又爆發第三次薩莫奈戰爭，並在往後兩百年間屢屢以民變的形式再起，公元前327年爆發、持續到公元前87年方被平息的義大利戰爭，薩莫奈人的名字就是那場戰爭最重要的旗號。制度上，這幾年幾乎所有的征伐都發生在本國境內，羅馬得以把每一次成功都轉化為政治資本；公元前367年的塞維利烏斯法與公元前342年的平民執政官改革，常被後世解讀為對這類戰爭負擔的回饋。編制上，波利比奧斯把羅馬三列縱隊與精銳中隊的編排歸於此類戰爭的經驗，雖然具體年代仍有爭議，但薩莫奈戰役確實是羅馬從兩列縱隊走向成熟戰團體系的關鍵幾年。文化上，這場戰爭同時塑造了雙方的自我形象：薩莫奈人因為抵抗而進入文學，維吉爾在《埃涅阿斯紀》第七卷把他們寫成薩拉斯特人，說他們住在薩爾努斯河一帶；羅馬人則因為這場勝仗而自認可以把義大利的邊疆收進自己的秩序，此後三百年的向外擴張，都建立在這二十多年奠定的信心之上。
impactEn: The direct consequence of this war was a decisive Roman advantage in central and southern Italy: the harbours, the taxes and the roads of Campania were in Roman hands, while Apulia and the hill cities withdrew to defend themselves. But the war did not wipe the Samnites out, and that matters just as much. The territory of the Samnite League, the political structure of its cities and its independent military tradition largely survived; neither debts nor prisoners were settled, and so a Third Samnite War broke out in 298 BC, and the rising returned again and again in the two following centuries under the banner of revolt, the Samnite name becoming the chief standard of the Italian War that began in 327 BC and was not put down until 87 BC. Institutionally, almost every levy of those years was fought inside the Roman frontier, and Rome was able to turn each success into political capital; the Servian law of 367 BC and the plebeian consular reform of 342 BC are commonly read by later writers as a repayment for the burdens of wars of this kind. In the army, Polybius attributes the three-line battle order and the reserve of picked troops to the experience of campaigns of this type, though the exact dating remains disputed; the Samnite wars were in any case the years in which Rome moved from a two-line order to a mature legionary system. In culture the war shaped the self-image of both sides. The Samnites entered literature through their resistance, Virgil naming them the Sarrastes in the seventh book of the Aeneid and placing them along the river Sarnus; the Romans, for their part, could from that victory regard themselves as the ordering power of Italy, and the three centuries of outward expansion that followed rest on the confidence this war of some twenty years had settled.
result: 公元前304年，薩莫奈人、埃特魯里亞人與翁布里亞人分別遣使與羅馬議和，戰爭以條約收束。從軍事上看，羅馬是勝方，而且勝得不完全：羅馬拿下了卡普阿的宗主權、奪取了盧凱里亞、控制了通往亞平寧的山口通道，卻沒有攻入薩莫奈各城的腹地，聯盟的政治結構幾乎原封不動，薩莫奈人仍然帶著自己的軍制、自己的語言與自己的裝備退回山裡。這是一種典型的羅馬式結果：用戰爭確定邊界與盟約，用最小的駐軍維持存在，把尚未征服的地區留在附庸與友邦的秩序裡。羅馬付出的代價則在內政，這場戰爭拖了二十三年，戰團制度與公民徵召被推到極限，戰後的立法者不斷以平民的負擔為理由削弱貴族對官職的壟斷，公元前342年的改革讓平民首次能坐到執政官的椅子上。薩莫奈人這邊也沒有得到真正的和平：他們的損失集中在公元前320年卡烏迪內山口的那一仗，成建制的老兵幾乎耗盡，山區各城靠結盟與遊擊撐過了二十多年，最終還是要在公元前298年面對第三次薩莫奈戰爭，最後一次全面臣服則要等到公元前290年、戰爭結束、奴隸制度固化之後。落到卡面那件亞述長矛上：它自頭到尾都沒有出現在義大利的山裡，卻可以說明這場戰爭的技術底色，前九世紀的亞述人用短柄長刃的矛在兩河流域的城牆上一個接一個撕開缺口，公元前四世紀的羅馬與薩莫奈人則用窄刃短矛、寬身短劍與亞麻胸甲在義大利的山道上一個接一個堵住隘口，兩者是同樣的活，只是工具不同。
resultEn: In 304 BC the Samnites, the Etruscans and the Umbrians sent envoys separately and made peace with Rome, and the war was closed by treaty. Militarily Rome was the winner, but only partly so. Rome gained the overlordship of Capua, took Luceria and held the passes that led into the Apennines, yet did not drive into the heart of the Samnite cities; the political structure of the league survived almost untouched, and the Samnites withdrew into the hills with their own military system, their own language and their own equipment. This is a typical Roman result: war to fix the frontier and the treaties, the smallest garrison to hold the ground, and the unconquered country left inside the order of allies and clients. What the war cost Rome was paid at home. It ran for twenty-three years, the legionary system and the citizen levy were pushed to their limit, and after the war the legislators kept citing the burden of the plebs as a reason for breaking the aristocratic monopoly of the magistracies; the reform of 342 BC put a plebeian in the consuls' chairs for the first time. The Samnites did not get a real peace either. Their losses were concentrated in the single day of 320 BC at the Caudine Forks, where the formed veteran infantry was nearly spent, and the hill cities held on for more than twenty years through alliances and raiding, only to face the Third Samnite War in 298 BC, with the last full submission coming in 290 BC when the war ended and the settlement of slavery hardened. Coming back to the spear on the card: it never appeared in the hills of Italy at all, and yet it can serve to show the technical colouring of this war. The Assyrians of the ninth century used short-shafted, long-bladed spears to open breach after breach in the city walls of Mesopotamia; the Romans and Samnites of the fourth century BC used narrow-bladed short spears, broad short swords and linen cuirasses to close defile after defile on the mountain paths of Italy. It is the same work, done with different tools.
